content: FastText: The fastText algorithm created by Facebook BIBREF10 assumes every word to be n-grams of character. It helps to give the vector representations for out of vocabuary words. For the current work, fasttext based word embedding is used for generating token vectors of dimension 300 BIBREF11. Each vector corresponding to the tweet is generated by taking the average of token vectors.
